desc: Implement direct case-analysis solver with cost-1/2/3 witnesses and exact operation-array output.
Fix sample 1 by selecting the minimum-cost solution with the earliest operation indices (prefer containment before union-cover or globally minimal pair) and re-run sample tests.
Validate edge cases (N=1, M=1/2/3, adjacent/equal intervals, ties, distinct indices) with a local checker that accepts any valid minimum-cost output.
Finalize stdin/stdout handling, exact formatting, and O(M log M) performance.
